description: Guided questionnaire to shape RAG queries for managed retreat decision-making. Answers are injected as context into the LLM prompt.

questions.text: What is the primary climate hazard your community faces?
Where are you in the managed retreat process?
options: Exploring whether retreat is an option
Building the case — gathering evidence and community support
Retreat is complete — managing post-relocation challenges

questions.text: What is your most pressing question right now?
options: How do we fund this? (buyouts, grants, compensation)
How do we get community consent and buy-in?
How do we protect vulnerable and low-income residents?
What are the legal and property rights barriers?
How do we choose and prepare the destination site?
How do we decide who must move vs who can stay?
What has worked or failed in similar communities?

questions.text: Is the retreat voluntary, incentivized, or mandated?
options: Voluntary — residents choose whether to move
Incentivized — buyouts or compensation offered to encourage moving
Mandated — residents are required to relocate

questions.text: What country or region are you in?
